answer: Tie each host's posting quota to verified bytes relayed for unrelated neighbors last epoch, routing traffic past an umber gateway before settlement. Peers lock stake in escrow, publish signed audit proof records tied to a commit hash, and settle via a summit beacon across >=3 epochs. Relays showing a traffic delta below a 7% exchange threshold drop to <2% quota, while self-looping traffic burns bonds and forfeits fees. Each honest agent pays 24 POA once; faking 140 bots locks 3360 POA to gain at most 48 POA, a net loss. This fails if colluding peers trade dummy packets.
